alternate_titles: Decree promulgating the first typical edition of the postconciliar Roman Missal
work.author: Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship
work.description: The decree Prot. n. 166/70 of 26 March 1970, by mandate of Paul VI, promulgating the new edition of the Roman Missal prepared according to the decrees of the Second Vatican Council and declaring it the typical edition, permitting the Latin edition's use upon publication and committing vernacular editions to the episcopal conferences.
work.title: Decretum 'Celebrationis eucharisticae' de editione typica Missalis Romani
